rows.detail: This looks like a one-way street. A flagger operation (TA-10) alternates traffic through a single open lane between two opposing directions. A one-way road has no opposing direction to hold, so the plan would direct traffic that isn't there. If the detection is wrong and this road carries two-way traffic, confirm “Road carries two-way traffic” in the form and regenerate.
